vision_text: To create a world where every human being is given the opportunity to realize their highest potential and transform into a divine being — living with wisdom, compassion, and unity with universal consciousness. We aspire to build an environment that nurtures inner growth, uplifts humanity, and fosters harmony across the planet.
mission_text: To guide the transformation of human consciousness (Jeeva) into divine consciousness (Shiva) — helping individuals move beyond limitations of the ego and awaken to higher awareness, inner peace, and oneness with the universal Self.
song_desc_sri_jeeveswarastakam: Sacred eight-verse hymn glorifying the divine qualities and spiritual teachings of Parama Pujya Sri Jeeveswara Yogi Gurudev
song_desc_gundello_gudi: Soulful Telugu devotional song celebrating the divine temple within the heart, awakening inner consciousness
song_desc_nirvana_shatkam: Timeless Advaita composition by Adi Shankaracharya declaring the pure consciousness beyond all dualities
song_desc_jeeveswara_yogi_taluva: Melodious devotional tribute expressing deep reverence and gratitude to the enlightened master Sri Jeeveswara Yogi
song_desc_pralaya_kala_beekara: Powerful invocation to Lord Kala Bhairava, the fierce guardian deity who destroys negativity and grants spiritual liberation
song_desc_ni_namamalo: Inspirational Telugu bhajan proclaiming that the gateway to liberation lies within the sacred name of the divine Guru
guru_journey_quote: I am Not here to prove that I am God, I am here to prove that you are God
guru_journey_para1: Parama Pujya SriJeeveswara Yogi was born with an awakened Kundalini. At the tender age of 8, during a meditation class at school, he naturally entered into a deep state of Samadhi for four hours. From that moment onward, his heart was filled with a burning curiosity to explore the mysteries of meditation.
guru_journey_para2: At the age of 13, guided by his spiritual quest, he traveled to the sacred land of Srisailam, a powerful abode of Lord Shiva. There, in a miraculous turn, he encountered his Guru — none other than Lord Shiva Himself. In the divine presence of his Guru, he spent three days and received profound, intense meditation techniques.
guru_journey_para3: Through years of dedicated practice, he eventually attained Enlightenment. Choosing to renounce worldly pursuits, he initially intended to enter Jeeva Samadhi, but on the divine guidance of his Guru, he redirected his life towards serving humanity. Leaving behind a flourishing professional career, he resolved to dedicate his entire life to spreading the sacred knowledge of Kundalini Sadhana.
guru_journey_para4: In 2017, he founded Siva Kundalini Sadhana, a non-profit spiritual organization with the mission of offering this divine practice freely to all seekers. Gurudev strongly believes that Salvation is the birthright of every human being, and thus he shares these teachings without any barriers or prerequisites.
guru_journey_para5: SriJeeveswara Yogi Gurudev is among the rarest of masters who bestow Shaktipatham (the direct transmission of energy from Guru to disciple) and Shivapatham, guiding seekers on the path to ultimate realization.
kundalini_science_para1: Kundalini is the primordial cosmic energy that lies dormant at the base of the spine. Often depicted as a coiled serpent, this divine feminine energy represents the creative force of the universe.
kundalini_science_para2: When awakened through proper Sadhana (spiritual practice), Kundalini rises through the seven chakras, activating higher states of consciousness and ultimately leading to self-realization and unity with the divine.
kundalini_science_para3: This ancient science, preserved in Vedic traditions for millennia, offers a systematic path to spiritual evolution, healing, and the fulfillment of human potential.
kundalini_subtitle: The Ancient Vedic Science of Spiritual Awakening
kundalini_section_3_title: An Ancient Science for Modern Seekers
kundalini_highlight_1: Kundalini — the divine feminine force — is the very source of creation, lying coiled and waiting at the base of the spine.
kundalini_highlight_2: When Kundalini rises through all seven chakras, the seeker attains Samadhi — union with the infinite.
kundalini_highlight_3: This timeless science has guided seekers for millennia — and it is available to you, right now.
kundalini_chakras_subtitle: The path of Kundalini through the energy centres
kundalini_quote: The Kundalini is not a metaphor. It is a living force within you, waiting to be awakened. When it rises, you do not just believe in the divine — you become it.
benefit_enhanced_energy_desc: Experience unlimited cosmic energy flowing through your being.
benefit_mental_clarity_desc: Achieve crystal clear focus and enhanced cognitive abilities.
benefit_emotional_balance_desc: Reduces stress, fear, and negativity, creating inner peace.
benefit_chakra_activation_desc: Aligns and energizes the body's subtle energy centers.
benefit_spiritual_awakening_desc: Expands consciousness and deepens connection with the Divine.
benefit_inner_transformation_desc: Brings self-realization and a purposeful, harmonious life.
chakra_root_desc: The Root Chakra represents our foundation and feeling of being grounded. It affects our survival instincts, security, and basic needs. When balanced, you feel safe, stable, and confident in facing life's challenges.
chakra_sacral_desc: The Sacral Chakra governs creativity, sexuality, and emotions. It represents pleasure, joy, and passion. When balanced, you experience healthy relationships, creativity flows naturally, and you embrace change with ease.
chakra_solar_plexus_desc: The Solar Plexus Chakra is your power center, governing self-esteem, confidence, and personal power. It influences your sense of control and willpower. When balanced, you feel confident, motivated, and have a strong sense of purpose.
chakra_heart_desc: The Heart Chakra represents love, compassion, and connection. It bridges physical and spiritual realms. When balanced, you experience unconditional love, forgiveness, empathy, and deep connections with others.
chakra_throat_desc: The Throat Chakra governs communication, self-expression, and truth. It allows you to speak your authentic truth. When balanced, you communicate clearly, listen actively, and express yourself confidently.
chakra_third_eye_desc: The Third Eye Chakra represents intuition, wisdom, and inner vision. It governs insight and spiritual awareness. When balanced, you trust your intuition, see beyond the physical, and have clarity of thought.
chakra_crown_desc: The Crown Chakra connects you to divine consciousness and universal energy. It represents enlightenment and spiritual connection. When balanced, you experience inner peace, wisdom, and a sense of oneness with all.
